faqs.q: What is the purity guarantee on your bulk research peptides?

Avoid repetitive freeze-thaw cycles and reconstitute only using sterile Bacteriostatic Water.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Our B2B Services

items.q: Do I need to be a licensed professional to access your B2B services?
items.a: Yes. All 99 Purity Peptides B2B services—including bulk catalog access, white-label packaging, dropshipping fulfillment, and custom laboratory synthesis—are strictly available to licensed professionals, medical wellness clinics, compounding pharmacies, and verified research entities. Business credential validation is required during onboarding.

items.q: What is the minimum order volume for your wholesale peptide dropshipping program?
items.a: Our wholesale dropshipping program features no massive upfront inventory storage fees. However, to maintain your custom brand integration and secure our highest-tier pricing brackets, we require a minimum commitment of 20 unit fulfillments per month. This threshold is discussed and adjusted based on your specific compound catalog during onboarding.

items.q: How long does it take to launch a custom private label or white label peptide line?
items.a: The end-to-end timeline for launching a custom private label peptide product line ranges from 2 to 4 weeks. This includes business verification, label compliance review, packaging and custom branding finalization, synthesis verification of your selected batches, and direct integration into our domestic logistics pipeline.

items.q: Can I use your website development or launch support if I source compounds elsewhere?
items.a: No. Our high-performance digital infrastructure services—such as custom Next.js portal development, automated compliance routing, and business calculators—are premium value-added B2B benefits reserved exclusively for active, high-volume B2B accounts that source their lyophilized peptides through 99 Purity Wholesale.

items.q: How do you guarantee the purity of compounds shipped in dropshipping or private label orders?
items.a: Every single peptide batch manufactured in our U.S. laboratories undergoes rigorous double-pass High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) and Mass Spectrometry (LC-MS) analysis. Each dropshipped or private-labeled order is matched directly to its verified batch Certificate of Analysis (COA) confirming a minimum purity of ≥99%.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept for high-volume wholesale peptide contracts?
items.a: To ensure immediate transaction clearance and operational speed, we accept Bitcoin (BTC) for immediate domestic processing, Zelle for mid-tier transactions, and standard corporate bank transfers (ACH/Wire) for high-volume contract manufacturing accounts. Customized billing cycles are available for qualified long-term partners.

items.q: Are dropshipped and private label peptides shipped under cold chain packaging?
items.a: Our peptides are synthesized and purified to the highest industry standards, then lyophilized into a highly stable solid powder form. Lyophilized peptides remain molecularly stable at room temperatures during standard domestic shipping, eliminating the need for cold-chain transit. However, we utilize vacuum-sealed, thermally buffered B2B packaging to ensure complete environmental protection.

items.q: Do you offer custom peptide synthesis for unique research concentrations or novel sequences?
items.a: Yes. Our U.S.-based chemical synthesis laboratories can formulate custom concentration sizes, custom milligram weights (e.g., custom 20mg BPC-157 or 50mg Tirzepatide vials), or custom amino acid sequences for qualified B2B partners. Custom synthesis runs require a minimum batch contract volume which will be detailed during consultation.

items.q: How are shipping, customs delays, and tracking handled for dropshipped orders?
items.a: Since all of our manufacturing, warehousing, and fulfillment operations are located domestically within the United States, your dropshipped orders face zero international customs risks, border delays, or seizure exposures. We ship all B2B parcels via express couriers with automated API tracking sent directly to your sales portal.

items.q: What are the legal compliance frameworks surrounding white labeling research compounds?
items.a: All materials supplied under our private label and white label programs are strictly labeled and designated for laboratory, analytical, and in-vitro scientific research applications only. Resellers are legally responsible for ensuring their product marketing, digital storefronts, and target clients operate fully within these legal research-use frameworks.

items.q: Can I request batch-matched HPLC report verification before my dropship fulfillment?
items.a: Yes. Transparency is a core pillar of our B2B partnership. Business partners can request batch-matched HPLC and Mass Spectrometry reports for the specific manufacturing lot currently allocated to their inventory or fulfillment queue at any time.

items.q: What support channels do B2B clients have access to for operational issues?
items.a: All wholesale, dropshipping, and private label partners are assigned a dedicated U.S. B2B Account Manager. You receive direct access to our priority WhatsApp hotline and direct email desks, ensuring any logistical, technical, or custom ordering inquiries are fully resolved within 2 business hours.

hplc.title: HPLC (High-Performance Liquid Chromatography)
hplc.definition: The primary analytical chemistry technique used to separate, identify, and quantify each component in a mixture. At 99 Purity Wholesale, we use HPLC to verify that our research compounds exceed the ≥99% purity threshold.

lyophilized.title: Lyophilized
lyophilized.definition: The process of freeze-drying a compound to remove water while preserving its chemical structure. This results in a stable, powdered form that is ideal for long-term storage and transport without requiring a constant cold chain.

glp1-agonist.title: GLP-1 Agonist
glp1-agonist.definition: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 receptor agonists are a class of research compounds that mimic the GLP-1 hormone. In research settings, these are studied for their effects on glucose metabolism, insulin secretion, and appetite regulation.

secretagogue.title: Secretagogue
secretagogue.definition: A substance that promotes secretion. In peptide research, growth hormone secretagogues (GHS) like Ipamorelin or CJC-1295 are studied for their ability to stimulate the pituitary gland to release endogenous growth hormone.

moq.title: MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity)
moq.definition: The smallest amount of a product that a wholesale supplier is willing to sell. For 99 Purity Wholesale, our MOQ is typically 10 units (1 kit), which allows us to maintain competitive wholesale pricing for professional clients.

coa.title: COA (Certificate of Analysis)
coa.definition: A document issued by an analytical laboratory that confirms a product meets its quality specifications. Our COAs include HPLC and Mass Spectrometry data to prove purity and identity.

dac.title: DAC (Drug Affinity Complex)
dac.definition: A technology used to increase the half-life of a peptide by allowing it to bind to albumin in the bloodstream. CJC-1295 with DAC has a significantly longer duration of action in research models compared to CJC-1295 without DAC.

no-dac.title: No-DAC (CJC-1295 without DAC / Mod GRF 1-29)
no-dac.definition: The version of CJC-1295 that does not include the Drug Affinity Complex. It has a shorter half-life and is often preferred in research where precise control over growth hormone pulses is required.

spps.title: SPPS (Solid-Phase Peptide Synthesis)
spps.definition: The standard method for chemical peptide synthesis. It involves building a peptide chain by adding amino acids one by one while the chain is tethered to a solid support. This method is used in our U.S. facility for high-purity production.

research-grade.title: Research Grade
research-grade.definition: A specification indicating that a compound is intended exclusively for laboratory research and is not for human or animal consumption. Our research-grade peptides are produced to the highest analytical standards (≥99%).

hgh.title: HGH (Human Growth Hormone)
hgh.definition: A hormone produced by the pituitary gland that stimulates growth, cell reproduction, and cell regeneration. Many peptides in our catalog are studied for their role as HGH secretagogues.

peptide-api.title: Peptide API (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient)
peptide-api.definition: The pure peptide compound used as the active component in research formulations. We supply bulk APIs to compounding pharmacies and researchers.

purity-threshold.title: Purity Threshold
purity-threshold.definition: The minimum acceptable percentage of the target compound in a batch. 99 Purity Wholesale enforces a strict ≥99% threshold, verified by third-party analysis.

cas-number.title: CAS Number
cas-number.definition: A unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance. It ensures unambiguous identification of research compounds in scientific literature and procurement.
